then.text: Still glowing? So's the prom. Come back every autumn, the lights run till early November.
Fuses from Alf's tram, spare bulbs from Southport Pier, then somebody famous for the switch. Try Uncle Norman at the Winter Gardens: he knows everybody, and he'll tell you so.

else.text: Oh, thank goodness, a pair of hands! Doreen, Illuminations Depot. It's switch-on night and everything that can go wrong has gone wrong.
The fuse boxes have blown, I'm short of bulbs, and the celebrity's stuck on the M55 with a flat tyre and a film crew.
Tram Driver Alf keeps spare fuses in his cab: he's at the tram stop on the prom. Get those, then we'll talk bulbs.
